data.title: 妮姆芙 · 钟楼顶端微风水手服的青空眺望
data.description: 小镇学校古典钟楼顶层的露天阳台，妮姆芙身穿深蓝初中海军水手服，双马尾随风拂动，手握纸风车，静静远眺广阔无垠的自由天空。
data.location: 古典红砖学校钟楼观景台
data.action: 双手扶着石砌护栏，水蓝色双马尾如丝绸般随强风在空中飘扬，神情恬静而深情地望着蓝天白云
data.lighting: 清澈透明的高空晨光，晴空万里，微风拂动发丝的高光层次分明
data.camera: 背侧平视微仰，将少女的娇小背影与浩瀚晴空完美结合
data.promptProse: Nymph stands atop the open-air balcony of a classic red-brick school bell tower, resting both hands gently on the weathered stone parapet. Dressed in a charming navy junior high sailor uniform, a strong summer breeze whips her long aqua twintails and pleated skirt into dynamic ribbons against the immense blue sky. Holding a small colorful pinwheel, she looks peacefully into the endless horizon. Pristine morning sunlight shines unobstructed across the open bell tower summit, illuminating fluttering sailor uniform ribbons against the vast azure sky.
data.animaCaption: High on the breezy stone bell tower balcony, Nymph watches the horizon as gusts of wind lift her aqua twin-tails. Pristine morning sunlight shines unobstructed across the open bell tower summit, illuminating fluttering sailor uniform ribbons against the vast azure sky.
